detail.command: set -euo pipefail; rm -rf /tmp/WeatherFlowDerived; xcodebuild -project WeatherFlow.xcodeproj -scheme WeatherFlow -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath /tmp/WeatherFlowDerived CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build | tee /tmp/weatherflow-build.log; echo '=== APP ==='; find /tmp/WeatherFlowDerived/Build/Products -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'WeatherFlow.app' -print; echo '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short
